fusions.name: Gutting Stroke
fusions.desc: A gutting stroke that deals 16 slashing damage and uses up every affliction you have on the target, with 60% more damage for each one used up. The wound is left [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Up the Sleeve
fusions.desc: Flicks a hidden barb that deals 4 piercing damage, with 50% more critical chance against an enemy that has not yet been wounded.

fusions.name: Whetted Point
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Between the Rings
fusions.desc: Your piercing attacks ignore 12% of the target's armour.
